name: AITextLink
description: AITextLink is the canonical inline link for AI explainability surfaces. It supports six variants: text-only, icon-leading, accordion chevron, icon + chevron, external navigation, and attention (orange
intent: Not a generic product link. The AI-specific text link treatment used when an AI output needs to expose its reasoning, sources, assumptions, or governance information.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.name: label
props.hint: Link text. Must make purpose clear without relying on icon alone.

props.name: href
props.hint: URL for navigation links. Omit for in-page disclosure/callback actions.

props.name: icon
props.hint: Leading icon name from INLINE_ICON_PATHS (info, database, history, shield-check, flag, link, error-circle)

props.name: showChevron
props.hint: Show accordion chevron. Automatically set by variant="chevron" or "icon-chevron".

props.name: expanded
props.hint: Controlled expanded state for accordion links

props.name: disabled
props.hint: Disable the link. Always pair with disabledReason.

props.name: disabledReason
props.hint: Explains why the link is unavailable. Shown as tooltip title + aria-label.

props.name: loading
props.hint: Show spinner while source is resolving; replaces leading icon

props.name: external
props.hint: Force external-link icon; equivalent to variant="external"

props.name: onClick
props.hint: Click callback for non-href action links

notes: Attention/orange tone reserved for escalation, approval, stale data only.

experienceMetadata.accountability: Sources · Rationale · Assumptions · Confidence · Audit trail · Data freshness
